summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd, a Cayman Islands company, filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K) reporting amendments to its amended and restated memorandum of association. The memorandum was adopted by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting and filed with the Cayman Islands Registrar on July 31, 2026. The filing contains no transaction-specific terms, prices, recommendations, or structural events beyond standard corporate governance changes. No deal, activist, strategic review, or similar special-situation event is identified; the amendment appears routine in nature. What to watch: upcoming 20-F annual report or subsequent disclosures for substantive operating or financing changes.
